2014_spells.illusory-dragon.description: By gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The illusion lasts for the duration and occupies its space as if it were a creature.
2014_spells.illusory-dragon.effectSummar: Create a magical effect at a point you choose
2014_spells.illusory-dragon.fullDescript: Using 1 action, by gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The illusion lasts for the duration and occupies its space as if it were a creature. The illusion lasts for the duration and occupies its space as if it were a creature; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
